cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The tent falling is our planned turning point. Remember the loose peg I mentioned? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then nobody would understand why it mattered later.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the earlier remark about waterproof coats has become remarkably well placed.
